text:
alex: Quick follow-up from the token-validation postmortem — want to lock owners + timelines and call out the recurring pattern. TL;DR: validation bug + stale service-account creds + missing audit hooks.

maria: Agree. I sketched action items after the retro, posting them here so we can assign. short list: 1) add stricter token expiry checks, 2) rotate service account with automation, 3) enable detailed audit logging on auth path, 4) add e2e for prefix-cache + token reuse.

jamal: I can own #2 (rotation automation) and the follow-up rollout. ETA 2 weeks for a v1 automation (script + cron job). @alex do you want this as a reserved task in next sprint?

alex: yes please, put it in sprint-42. add a canary and rollback plan.

emily: For #3 (audit logging) — we currently have sparse events for token validation. Need to add structured events: user, svc_acct, token_id, validation_result. I'll open a PR to ship the schema and a logging wrapper. ETA 4 days.

maria: For #1 I prototyped a quick guard in the validation layer:
```python
def validate_token(t):
    if t.expires_at < now() - timedelta(seconds=30):
        return False  # drop tokens that are effectively expired
```
I also added a metric `auth.token.stale_drops` so we can track prevalence. Filed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth/pull/482

security-bot: Automated note: runbook link added -> https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/auth-token-rotation. See checklist items pre-deploy.

sre-bot: CI status auth/pull/482: all checks passed. deploy-staging queued.

jamal: Planning note for rotation automation: will use `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create` + KMS wrapping + update k8s secrets via sealed-secrets. Will include blue/green secret rollout to avoid transient failures.

emily: Double-check: do we have a place to surface audit logs to SIEM? Right now only 30d retention in GCP. If we want long-term trend detection for these recurring incidents, we should push to the ELK/Splunk pipeline.

alex: Good call. @maria can you add an action to ship audit pipeline hook to logging team? Put an MVP with 90d retention and tag events with `incident_pattern=authz_token_drift`.

maria: Added ticket AUTH-2378 -> owners: maria (lead), emily (logs), infra (support). ETA: MVP in 10 business days.

jamal: I'll also add a periodic validation job that scans live tokens and flags approx-expired ones. Script will run daily; open-sourced in infra-tools. Ticket INFRA-1191.

emily: For tests: I'll add an integration that injects expired tokens and asserts the validation wrapper rejects and emits the metric. Tests will be in auth/integration/test_token_validations.py.

alex: Recurrence check — this pattern has shown up 3x in the last 9 months. Let's make remediation time-bound: owners must provide a status update at 7 days and 14 days. After 14 days escalate to security leadership.

maria: Noted. I'll post weekly status in this thread and update AUTH-2378.

jamal: Can confirm rotation automation draft PR will include a dry-run mode + a `--preview` that prints changed secrets. Will link PR when ready.

security-bot: Reminder: policy requires secrets rotation cadence <= 90 days. Current svc acct key age: 124 days -> non-compliant.

emily: yikes. That explains the stale creds hit. I'll prioritize the audit pipeline hook to detect key ages automatically.

alex: Action owners recap: jamal (#2 rotation automation, INFRA-1191), maria (#1 validation + metrics, AUTH-2378 lead), emily (#3 audit logging & tests, ships logging schema), infra (support for sealed-secrets + SIEM hookup). Timelines: jamal 2w, maria 10d, emily 4d for initial logging PR + 10d for SIEM hook.

maria: I'll also prepare a short runbook snippet for oncall: steps to remediate if token-validation starts failing in prod (include `kubectl exec` checks and how to trigger rotation).

alex: thanks all. please link PRs and update tickets in 48 hours. we'll reconvene in this thread for weekly status. :thumbsup:

jamal: linked INFRA-1191 and added draft PR in progress.

emily: created AUTH-2380 for test work.

maria: AUTH-2378 updated with first status (day 1). closing loop for now.
